snippet.title: Mafia: The Old Country - “Family Takes Sacrifice” Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Available to play on August 8th: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1001-PPSA14251_00-00000NEROPS5SIEA

Enzo’s oath, with all the power, temptation, and hardship it entails, is a burning reminder of this simple truth:

Family Takes Sacrifice. 🗡️🔥

Mafia: The Old Country is rolling out worldwide for PlayStation 5!

Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily.

Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure.

#ps5 #ps5games #mafia #mafiathegame 

Rated Mature
